handoff.plan:
starter_template:
  mode: none
  rationale: The client mockups define a card queue on a diagonal road with a live mirror face; no
    catalog template combines expression matching with this queue, so build from scratch reusing the
    Mamamy kit.
mechanic_rationale: "Mockups MMM SBD Effect 4 1-2 and the user's answers pin the loop down: six
  expression cards in a queue, the player's face is classified live into one of the six expressions,
  a held match passes the front card; no timer."
game_type:
  camera_feed: visible
  ar_tracking: face
  core_loop_seconds: 3
  total_duration_seconds: 25
camera_feed_constraints:
  tracking_type: face
  tracking_range: single front-camera face, head and shoulders in frame
  user_image_visible: true
  composition: none
mechanic:
  class: other
  description: A diagonal road runs from bottom-left to top-right with a queue of six baby-face
    expression cards; the front card is the target. The player's face is classified every frame into
    tongue-out, crying, wink-smile, sad, neutral or smile and the big baby face on the road mirrors
    that classification. Holding the target expression for about half a second passes the front card
    and the queue advances. After six cards the MEGA MAMAMY 19 result with confetti and PLAY AGAIN.
  parameters:
    cards: 6
    hold_sec: 0.5
    expressions:
      - tongue
      - cry
      - wink
      - sad
      - neutral
      - smile
screens:
  - name: Intro
    role: intro
    initial_visible: true
    layout:
      - id: intro_hint
        element: brand text hint
        position: center, y=+300
        kind: hud
      - id: intro_button
        element: brand pink pill RECORD TO PLAY
        position: center, y=+220
        kind: button
        interactive: true
  - name: Gameplay
    role: gameplay
    initial_visible: true
    layout:
      - id: road
        element: diagonal white road
        position: lower screen, bottom-left to top-right
        kind: decoration
      - id: cards
        element: queue of six expression cards
        position: along the road, front card near the centre right
        kind: playable
      - id: mirror_face
        element: big baby face mirroring the player's expression
        position: on the road, lower centre
        kind: playable
  - name: Result
    role: result
    initial_visible: false
    layout:
      - id: result_logo
        element: MEGA MAMAMY 19 logo
        position: center
        kind: result
      - id: retry_button
        element: pink pill PLAY AGAIN
        position: below logo
        kind: button
        interactive: true
      - id: confetti
        element: Sparkly Confetti
        position: full screen
        kind: decoration
interactions:
  - kind: record_start_reset
    trigger: APJS.EventType.RecordStart
    response: Shuffle six cards and start matching
    state_change: any -> PLAYING
    target:
      scope: none
      rationale: global lifecycle event
  - kind: screen_transition
    trigger: tap RECORD TO PLAY
    response: Same as record start
    state_change: INTRO -> PLAYING
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - intro_button
    feedback:
      visual: intro text hides
  - kind: gameplay_action
    trigger: player's face matches the front card for 0.5s
    response: Front card flies off, queue advances
    state_change: PLAYING -> PLAYING, or RESULT after the sixth card
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - cards
        - mirror_face
    feedback:
      visual: card pops away, mirror face bounces
  - kind: retry
    trigger: tap anywhere on RESULT after 1.3s
    response: Restart
    state_change: RESULT -> PLAYING
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - retry_button
    feedback:
      visual: result hides
assets:
  - id: asset.road
    role: background prop
    description: White felt diagonal road layer (TACH HINH 1) across the lower screen
    is_background: false
    count: 1
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: decoration
    kind: visual
  - id: asset.cards
    role: expression cards
    description: "Six cream cards with baby-face expressions: tongue-out, crying, wink-smile, sad,
      neutral, smile"
    is_background: false
    count: 6
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: addressable_part
    kind: visual
  - id: asset.faces
    role: mirror faces
    description: The same six expressions as large baby faces for the live mirror
    is_background: false
    count: 6
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: decoration
    kind: visual
random_behaviors:
  - what: card order
    range: shuffle of the six expressions each round
    verify_strategy: log the order via get_script_logs
criteria:
  - category: layout
    check: Road, card queue and mirror face sit where the mockup puts them
  - category: state
    check: Mirror face changes with the detected expression
  - category: state
    check: Holding the front card's expression passes exactly one card
  - category: state
    check: A different expression does not pass the card
  - category: state
    check: After six cards the result shows logo, confetti and PLAY AGAIN
  - category: camera_feed
    check: Camera feed visible above the road
scene_representation:
  planning_mode: explicit
  decision_summary: Flat 2D screen-space scene over the camera feed; one APJS script reads face
    tracking each frame, classifies the expression, drives the mirror face and the card queue.
  space:
    kind: screen
    description: 720x1280 ScreenTransform space
  content_form:
    kind: flat_2d
    description: PNG sprites on Screen Images
  requirements:
    - id: req.face
      description: Face expression classification drives the mirror and passes cards
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.game
      verification_refs:
        - ver.face
    - id: req.flow
      description: Six cards then result
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.game
        - layer.ui
      verification_refs:
        - ver.face
    - id: req.camera
      description: Camera feed visible
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.camera
      verification_refs:
        - ver.face
  layers:
    - id: layer.game
      role: gameplay
      description: Road, cards, mirror face
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: screen
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: flat_2d
      requirement_refs:
        - req.face
        - req.flow
    - id: layer.ui
      role: overlays
      description: Intro, result, confetti
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: screen
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: flat_2d
      requirement_refs:
        - req.flow
    - id: layer.camera
      role: backdrop
      description: Camera feed
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: screen
      content_form:
        kind: camera_feed
        description: camera_feed
      requirement_refs:
        - req.camera
  verification:
    - id: ver.face
      description: Face preview video + probe logs show the classifier output; demo mode records the full flow
      requirement_refs:
        - req.face
        - req.flow
        - req.camera
      views_or_states:
        - intro
        - playing
        - card_pass
        - result
      success_criteria: |-
        classifier output changes with the face
        cards pass
        result shows
        camera feed visible
  fallbacks:
    unknown_requirement: adapt_and_verify
    unmet_must: stop_and_explain
plan_type: game
